content:
Track: Introduction to Data Analysis with SQL & Python
    - Lesson 1: SQL Fundamentals for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 2: Querying Relational Databases with SQL
    - Lesson 3: Intermediate SQL: Joins, Aggregations, and Subqueries
    - Lesson 4: Introduction to Python Programming for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 5: Exploring Libraries in Python (NumPy & Pandas)
    - Lesson 6: Data Cleaning with Python: Handling Missing Values & Outliers
    - Lesson 7: Data Manipulation with Python: Grouping, Filtering, and Reshaping Data
    - Lesson 8: Data Visualization Basics with Matplotlib
    - Lesson 9: Advanced Data Visualization Techniques with Seaborn
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)

   Track: Intermediate SQL & Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Advanced Querying Techniques in SQL
    - Lesson 2: Building Complex Queries with Subqueries & CTEs
    - Lesson 3: Performance Optimization of SQL Queries
    - Lesson 4: Working with Large Datasets in Python (Part 1)
    - Lesson 5: Working with Large Datasets in Python (Part 2): Using Pandas Efficiently
    - Lesson 6: Data Transformation Techniques in Python
    - Lesson 7: Introduction to Machine Learning for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 8: Basic Statistical Modeling & Hypothesis Testing
    - Lesson 9: Exploring Supervised Learning Algorithms (Regression)
    - Lesson 10: Applying Machine Learning Models with Scikit-learn Library

   Track: Data Analysis Projects
    - Lesson 1: Designing a Data Analysis Project
    - Lesson 2: Collecting and Importing Data for the Project
    - Lesson 3: Performing Exploratory Data Analysis on the Project Data
    - Lesson 4: Cleaning, Transforming, & Preparing the Project Data
    - Lesson 5: Building and Evaluating Machine Learning Models on the Project Data
    - Lesson 6: Presenting Data Analysis Findings (Data Visualization & Reports)
    - Lesson 7: Validating the Project Results and Identifying Potential Improvements
    - Lesson 8: Iterating on the Project to Enhance Results and Efficiency
    - Lesson 9: Preparing for Freelance Data Analysis Opportunities
    - Lesson 10: Finalizing the Project Documentation & Sharing with Potential Clients

   Track: SQL for Efficient Data Querying
    - Lesson 1: Advanced Performance Optimization Techniques in SQL
    - Lesson 2: Indexes, Partitions, and Materialized Views
    - Lesson 3: SQL Window Functions & Ranking Operations
    - Lesson 4: Using JSON data types with SQL
    - Lesson 5: Querying Big Data Systems (Hadoop/Spark) with SQL
    - Lesson 6: Advanced Database Management with SQL
    - Lesson 7: Database Design for Scalability & Performance
    - Lesson 8: Securing Access to Databases with Authentication & Authorization
    - Lesson 9: Monitoring and Tuning Database Systems
    - Lesson 10: Best Practices for Data Querying with SQL

   Track: Python Libraries for Advanced Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Advanced Pandas Techniques (Merging, Pivoting)
    - Lesson 2: Working with Geospatial Data in Python
    - Lesson 3: Text Mining and Natural Language Processing in Python
    - Lesson 4: Web Scraping & API Integration with Python
    - Lesson 5: Time Series Analysis with Pandas & Statistics Libraries
    - Lesson 6: Probabilistic Graphical Models (PGMs) & Bayesian Networks
    - Lesson 7: Feature Engineering for Machine Learning Models
    - Lesson 8: Supervised Learning Algorithms (Decision Trees, Random Forests, XGBoost)
    - Lesson 9: Unsupervised Learning Algorithms (Clustering & Association Rules)
    - Lesson 10: Ensemble Learning Techniques for Improved Model Performance
